FLOYD-FORAYED true and FORAY-COUNTER below 4 is exactly that span: set 0 -> 1 on the turn he plunges, 2 and 3 the sounds through the shut door (traced from the bio-lock checkpoint, walkthrough steps 251-253); FLOYD has RLANDBIT excludes the case where he has died in there.
